statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study interprets whole-genome duplication coupled with diploidization as a candidate driver of the diversification of CAM physiotypes in Clusia.
statements.evidence: Our results indicate that whole-genome duplication coupled to diploidization might have driven diversification of CAM physiotypes in Clusia
statements.note: The abstract's conclusion names whole-genome duplication coupled to diploidization as a possible driver of CAM physiotype diversification in Clusia.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Genome sequences were generated and compared for three Clusia species whose CAM ranges from weak through inducible to strong.
statements.evidence: Here, we sequence and compare the genomes of three Clusia species spanning weak, inducible, and strong CAM.
statements.note: The abstract reports sequencing and comparing the genomes of three Clusia species spanning weak, inducible and strong CAM.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Introducing Clusia CAM-related genes into a C₃ crop enabled that crop to take up CO₂ at night.
statements.evidence: The diversity of CAM physiotypes has fueled a debate about evolutionary constraints and the feasibility of engineering CAM into C₃ crops.
statements.note: Engineering CAM into C₃ crops is mentioned only as a debated idea; the abstract reports no gene transfer into any crop.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The comparison implicates polyploidization, and a later transposon-mediated genic diploidization, in shaping CAM-related gene families, especially those controlling phosphoenol-pyruvate recycling via phosphorolytic leaf starch metabolism.
statements.evidence: We show that polyploidization followed by transposon-mediated genic diploidization could have shaped CAM-related gene families, particularly those controlling phosphoenol-pyruvate recycling via phosphorolytic leaf starch metabolism.
statements.note: The abstract places transposon-mediated genic diploidization after polyploidization and links both to CAM gene families, particularly those for phosphoenol-pyruvate recycling via leaf starch.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Slicing of target RNA by MILI yields two products: a 16-nucleotide by-product that is thrown away and a pre-piRNA intermediate that feeds phased piRNA production.
statements.evidence: Here we demonstrate that MILI slicing generates a 16-nt by-product that is discarded and a pre-piRNA intermediate that is used for phased piRNA production.
statements.note: The abstract shows MILI slicing makes a discarded 16-nt by-product and a pre-piRNA intermediate used for phased piRNA production.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Nuclear MIWI2 loaded with target-derived piRNAs silences transposons by directing DNA methylation of their promoters.
statements.evidence: A poorly understood adaptive pathway links cytoplasmic slicing of target RNA by the PIWI protein MILI to loading of target-derived piRNAs into nuclear MIWI2.
statements.note: The abstract mentions loading of piRNAs into nuclear MIWI2 but says nothing about how MIWI2 silences transposons or about DNA methylation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Although dispensable for piRNA biogenesis, the ATPase activity of TDRD9 is required for transposon silencing and for male fertility.
statements.evidence: In contrast, ATPase activity of TDRD9 is dispensable for piRNA biogenesis but is essential for transposon silencing and male fertility.
statements.note: The abstract contrasts TDRD9 with MVH: its ATPase activity is dispensable for piRNA biogenesis yet essential for transposon silencing and male fertility.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Processing of the pre-piRNA intermediate into piRNAs depends on the ATPase activity of MVH, and this activity secures transposon silencing and male fertility.
statements.evidence: The ATPase activity of Mouse Vasa Homolog (MVH) is essential for processing the intermediate into piRNAs, ensuring transposon silencing and male fertility.
statements.note: The abstract states MVH ATPase activity is essential for turning the intermediate into piRNAs, which ensures transposon silencing and male fertility.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: By binding the piRNA/Piwi complex, Su(var)2-10 bridges target recognition and the silencing effector, bringing in the SetDB1/Wde histone methyltransferase in a SUMO-dependent way.
statements.evidence: Su(var)2-10 links the piRNA-guided target recognition complex to the silencing effector by binding the piRNA/Piwi complex and inducing SUMO-dependent recruitment of the SetDB1/Wde histone methyltransferase effector.
statements.note: The abstract describes Su(var)2-10 binding the piRNA/Piwi complex and inducing SUMO-dependent recruitment of SetDB1/Wde, linking recognition to silencing.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Drosophila females lacking Su(var)2-10 in the germline are sterile.
statements.evidence: Here, we show that in Drosophila the small ubiquitin-like protein SUMO and the SUMO E3 ligase Su(var)2-10 are required for piRNA-guided deposition of repressive chromatin marks and transcriptional silencing of piRNA targets.
statements.note: The abstract reports that Su(var)2-10 is needed for repressive chromatin marks and silencing of piRNA targets, but it reports nothing about fertility.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Drosophila, SUMO and the SUMO E3 ligase Su(var)2-10 are needed for piRNA targets to be transcriptionally repressed and to acquire repressive chromatin marks.
statements.evidence: Here, we show that in Drosophila the small ubiquitin-like protein SUMO and the SUMO E3 ligase Su(var)2-10 are required for piRNA-guided deposition of repressive chromatin marks and transcriptional silencing of piRNA targets.
statements.note: The abstract shows SUMO and Su(var)2-10 are required for piRNA-guided repressive chromatin marks and transcriptional silencing of piRNA targets.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Repression of genomic parasites in Drosophila is proposed to rely on a conserved SUMO-dependent route for recruiting SetDB1/Wde that the nuclear piRNA pathway took over.
statements.evidence: We propose that in Drosophila, the nuclear piRNA pathway has co-opted a conserved mechanism of SUMO-dependent recruitment of the SetDB1/Wde chromatin modifier to confer repression of genomic parasites.
statements.note: The abstract proposes that the nuclear piRNA pathway co-opted a conserved SUMO-dependent SetDB1/Wde recruitment mechanism to repress genomic parasites.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Mili-deficient mice showed impaired long-term memory, mirroring the piRNA role described in Aplysia neurons.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, Mili mutant mice exhibit behavioral deficits such as hyperactivity and reduced anxiety.
statements.note: The behavioral deficits reported for Mili mutant mice are hyperactivity and reduced anxiety; memory is linked to piRNAs only in Aplysia and was not reported for the mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Mili mutant mice displayed behavioral abnormalities, including hyperactivity and reduced anxiety.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, Mili mutant mice exhibit behavioral deficits such as hyperactivity and reduced anxiety.
statements.note: The abstract lists hyperactivity and reduced anxiety among the behavioral deficits of Mili mutant mice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: RNA sequencing and protein analysis detected Mili and other piRNA biogenesis factors in mouse brain, plus low-level, mostly LINE1-derived small RNAs resembling testis piRNAs.
statements.evidence: revealed the presence in brain of several piRNA biogenesis factors including a mouse piwi (Mili), as well as small RNAs, albeit at low levels, resembling conserved piRNAs in mouse testes [primarily LINE1 (long interspersed nuclear element1) retrotransposon-derived]
statements.note: The sequencing and protein data showed piRNA biogenesis factors including Mili in brain, and low-level small RNAs resembling mostly LINE1-derived testis piRNAs.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Genome-wide single-base CpG methylation analysis showed that brain DNA of Mili-/- mice is hypomethylated, preferentially in intergenic regions and LINE1 promoters.
statements.evidence: single-base pair CpG methylation analyses across the genome of Mili/piRNA-deficient ( Mili -/- ) mice demonstrate that brain genomic DNA is preferentially hypomethylated within intergenic areas and LINE1 promoter areas of the genome
statements.note: The methylation analysis of Mili-/- mice found brain genomic DNA preferentially hypomethylated in intergenic areas and LINE1 promoter areas.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Efficient colocalization of the Microprocessor components DCL1 and HYL1 with RNA Polymerase II depends on both MTA and TGH.
statements.evidence: Both MTA and TGH are necessary for efficient colocalization of the Microprocessor components Dicer-like 1 (DCL1) and Hyponastic Leaves 1 (HYL1) with RNA Polymerase II.
statements.note: The abstract states that both MTA and TGH are necessary for DCL1 and HYL1 to colocalize efficiently with RNA Polymerase II.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Arabidopsis plants lacking MTA had lower microRNA levels while accumulating primary miRNA transcripts.
statements.evidence: Here, we show that an MTA-deficient mutant ( mta ) has decreased levels of microRNAs (miRNAs) but accumulates primary miRNA transcripts (pri-miRNAs).
statements.note: The MTA-deficient mta mutant showed decreased miRNA levels together with accumulation of pri-miRNAs.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Plants lacking MTA flowered later than wild-type Arabidopsis plants.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, our findings reveal that reduced miR393b levels likely contributes to the impaired auxin response phenotypes of mta mutant plants.
statements.note: The only mta phenotypes the abstract mentions are impaired auxin responses; flowering time is not reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: MTA methylates pri-miRNAs, and structure probing showed less secondary structure in their stem-loop regions in mta mutant plants.
statements.evidence: Moreover, pri-miRNAs are methylated by MTA, and RNA structure probing analysis reveals a decrease in secondary structure within stem-loop regions of these transcripts in mta mutant plants.
statements.note: The abstract reports that MTA methylates pri-miRNAs and that their stem-loop regions have decreased secondary structure in mta mutants.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Nxf3 binds piRNA precursors specifically and is required to move them to piRNA biogenesis sites, a step critical for silencing germline transposons.
statements.evidence: We found that Nxf3 specifically binds to piRNA precursors and is essential for their export to piRNA biogenesis sites, a process that is critical for germline transposon silencing.
statements.note: The abstract reports that Nxf3 specifically binds piRNA precursors and is essential for exporting them to biogenesis sites, which is critical for transposon silencing.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Export of dual-strand cluster transcripts depends on two factors, CG13741/Bootlegger and the nuclear export factor family protein Nxf3.
statements.evidence: Here we report that dual-strand cluster transcript export requires CG13741/Bootlegger and the Drosophila nuclear export factor family protein Nxf3.
statements.note: The abstract states that dual-strand cluster transcript export requires both CG13741/Bootlegger and Nxf3.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Bootlegger is recruited specifically to piRNA clusters, where it brings in Nxf3.
statements.evidence: Bootlegger is specifically recruited to piRNA clusters and in turn brings Nxf3.
statements.note: The abstract says Bootlegger is specifically recruited to piRNA clusters and in turn brings Nxf3.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Bootlegger and Nxf3 are likewise needed to export piRNA cluster transcripts in Drosophila testes.
statements.evidence: In Drosophila ovaries, most piRNAs originate from dual-strand clusters, which generate piRNAs from both genomic strands.
statements.note: The abstract describes dual-strand clusters in ovaries and germline silencing in general; it reports nothing about Bootlegger or Nxf3 in testes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Animals mutant for pptr-1, a gene needed to stabilize P granules in early embryos, show exceptionally strong heritable RNAi lasting tens of generations.
statements.evidence: Animals mutated in pptr-1, which is required for stabilization of P granules in the early embryo, display extraordinarily strong heritable RNAi responses, lasting for tens of generations.
statements.note: The abstract reports extraordinarily strong heritable RNAi responses in pptr-1 mutants that last for tens of generations.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Transgenerational RNAi defects in meg-3/4 mutant lineages are stronger when the mutant alleles are inherited through the paternal lineage.
statements.evidence: Further, whether the meg-3/4 mutant alleles were present in the paternal or maternal lineages leads to different transgenerational consequences.
statements.note: The abstract says paternal and maternal transmission of meg-3/4 alleles give different consequences but does not say which lineage gives stronger defects.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Even though HRDE-1 had been considered absolutely necessary for RNAi inheritance, hrde-1 mutants inherited RNAi once their germ granules were disrupted.
statements.evidence: Upon disruption of germ granules, hrde-1 mutants can inherit RNAi, although HRDE-1 was previously thought to be absolutely required for RNAi inheritance.
statements.note: The abstract reports that hrde-1 mutants can inherit RNAi upon germ granule disruption, despite the earlier view that HRDE-1 is absolutely required.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Some germ-granule mutants lost the ability to inherit small RNA-based silencing once they had been homozygous for many generations.
statements.evidence: Surprisingly, we show here that mutants with defective germ granules can nevertheless inherit potent small RNA-based silencing responses, but some of the mutants lose this ability after many generations of homozygosity.
statements.note: The abstract states that mutants with defective germ granules can inherit silencing, but some lose this ability after many generations of homozygosity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Unlike female mice, female hamsters lacking Mov10l1 are sterile, because their oocytes cannot support zygotic development.
statements.evidence: In contrast to mice, female Mov10l1 -/- hamsters are sterile because their oocytes do not sustain zygotic development.
statements.note: The abstract states that, in contrast to mice, female Mov10l1-/- hamsters are sterile because their oocytes do not sustain zygotic development.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In male hamsters without Mov10l1, establishment of spermatogonia was impaired, the transcriptome was dysregulated, and expression of a young retrotransposon subfamily sharply increased.
statements.evidence: Furthermore, Mov10l1 -/- male hamsters have impaired establishment of spermatogonia accompanied by transcriptome dysregulation and an expression surge of a young retrotransposon subfamily.
statements.note: The abstract reports impaired spermatogonia establishment, transcriptome dysregulation and an expression surge of a young retrotransposon subfamily in Mov10l1-/- males.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The oocytes of Mov10l1-deficient female hamsters fail because retrotransposon insertions damage their genomes.
statements.evidence: In contrast to mice, female Mov10l1 -/- hamsters are sterile because their oocytes do not sustain zygotic development.
statements.note: The abstract says the oocytes do not sustain zygotic development but gives no cause, and reports no retrotransposon insertions in females.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Knocking out Mov10l1, an RNA helicase essential for piRNA biogenesis, produced striking phenotypes in both male and female golden hamsters.
statements.evidence: The loss of the Mov10l1 RNA helicase-an essential piRNA biogenesis factor-leads to striking phenotypes in both sexes.
statements.note: The abstract states that loss of the Mov10l1 RNA helicase, an essential piRNA biogenesis factor, leads to striking phenotypes in both sexes.

statements.text: In the weak Arabidopsis dbr1-2 mutant, lariat RNAs increased globally while miRNA accumulation fell across the genome.
statements.evidence: showed that a global increase in lariat RNAs was unexpectedly accompanied by a genome-wide reduction in miRNA accumulation

statements.text: The dbr1-2 mutation left expression of miRNA biogenesis genes and pri-miRNAs unchanged but impaired pri-miRNA association with the DCL1/HYL1 dicing complex.
statements.evidence: The dbr1-2 mutation had no effects on expression of miRNA biogenesis genes or primary miRNAs (pri-miRNAs), but the association of pri-miRNAs with the DCL1/HYL1 dicing complex was impaired.
